question: In a vector-product investigation, students consider $\vec{a}=\hat{i}-\hat{j}+2\hat{k}$ and $\vec{b}=2\hat{i}+\hat{j}$. They first compare $\vec{a}\times\vec{b}$ with $\vec{b}\times\vec{a}$ to examine the effect of reversing the order. They then multiply the vectors by $2$ and $-3$ respectively and study how these scalar factors affect the cross product and the area represented by its magnitude.(a) Evaluate $\vec{a}\times\vec{b}$.(b) Calculate $\vec{b}\times\vec{a}$ and compare it with $\vec{a}\times\vec{b}$.(c) Evaluate $(2\vec{a})\times(-3\vec{b})$ and express it in terms of $\vec{a}\times\vec{b}$.(d) Find the area of the triangle having $2\vec{a}$ and $-3\vec{b}$ as adjacent sides.
explanation: (a)\\vec{a}\\times\\vec{b}=\\begin{vmatrix}\\hat{i} & \\hat{j} & \\hat{k}\\\\1 & -1 & 2\\\\2 & 1 & 0\\end{vmatrix}`\vec{a}\times\vec{b}=-2\hat{i}+4\hat{j}+3\hat{k}`(b)Reversing the order of a vector product changes its sign. Therefore,`\vec{b}\times\vec{a}=-(\vec{a}\times\vec{b})\vec{b}\times\vec{a}=2\hat{i}-4\hat{j}-3\hat{k}`Thus, the two products have equal magnitudes and opposite directions.(c)Using the scalar multiplication property,`(2\vec{a})\times(-3\vec{b})=(2)(-3)(\vec{a}\times\vec{b})=-6(-2\hat{i}+4\hat{j}+3\hat{k})=12\hat{i}-24\hat{j}-18\hat{k}`(d)The magnitude of $\vec{a}\times\vec{b}$ is`|\vec{a}\times\vec{b}|=\sqrt{(-2)^2+4^2+3^2}=\sqrt{29}`Therefore,`|(2\vec{a})\times(-3\vec{b})|=6\sqrt{29}`The area of the triangle is one-half of this magnitude:`\text{Area}=\frac{1}{2}(6\sqrt{29})=3\sqrt{29}`Hence, the area is $3\sqrt{29}$ square units.
